name: marinara-rpg-extension
description: Custom RPG rulesets for Marinara Engine's Game Mode. System-agnostic framework with two complete reference rulesets (D&D 5e, Exalted 3e), AI-feedable build documentation, and a six-agent architecture (main GM + state-mutator, state-reminder, combat-adjudicator, lore-query, npc-bookkeeper). Build a ruleset for any tabletop RPG by writing three source files plus optional per-system agent overrides.
